settings.title: Home Widget Boards
settings.description: Choose which boards' posts appear in the home page recent and popular posts widgets.
settings.notice: This only controls visibility and does not change read permissions. The notice ticker is not affected.
settings.help: Drag a card between the two areas, or use the X / + button on the card. New boards are included automatically.
settings.included_hint: Boards whose posts appear in the widgets
settings.excluded_hint: Boards whose posts are hidden from the widgets
settings.empty_excluded: Drop a card here to hide that board from the widgets.
